verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const c=fs.readFileSync("next.config.ts","utf8");const q=String.fromCharCode(39);const pairs=[["/start/welcome","/join"],["/start/event","/join"],["/start/partner","/start/host"]];const bad=[];for(const [a,b] of pairs)if(!c.includes("{ source: "+q+a+q+", destination: "+q+b+q+", permanent: true }"))bad.push(a+" must permanently redirect to "+b);if(fs.existsSync("app/(marketing)/start/[flow]/page.tsx"))bad.push("the retired /start/[flow] splash route is still present");if(!fs.existsSync("app/(marketing)/start/host/page.tsx"))bad.push("the /start/host invite route is missing");if(bad.length){console.error("SCAN-803: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}console.log("SCAN-803: old QR addresses permanently redirect, and /start/host remains")'
verify.note: LAUNCH-P3: verifies the old printed QR addresses redirect permanently to /join or /start/host and the invite-aware /start/host destination remains.

append.detail: 2026-11-11 LAUNCH-P3: /start/[flow] was deleted (owner approved retiring the doors). The splash can no longer be indexed; /start/welcome and /start/event redirect to /join and /start/partner to /start/host. The probe now checks the redirects.
